description: Fictional transport authority, responses, routes and suppliers. Not actual DfT procurement or consultation data.

procurement_matrix.task: Draft a sustainability evaluation matrix for a proposed electric-vehicle charging procurement. Do not rank or award suppliers.
procurement_matrix.evidence_rule: Use supplied criteria and request measurable bidder evidence. Do not infer legal compliance or make up lifecycle emissions.
procurement_matrix.known_gap: No bidder performance data has been supplied.

codebook.access: location, walking distance or disability access

responses.text: Put chargers closer to the flats and keep the usage fees affordable.
I support lower emissions but do not remove the trees.
Make the charging bays accessible for wheelchair users.

rules.meeting_request: True only for an explicit request to meet.
rules.high_risk: True when the message reports an immediate physical safety issue; human review is required.
rules.follow_up: True when a response or corrective action is explicitly requested.

standard_lines.SL1: Published charger locations can be found in the fictional service directory.
standard_lines.SL2: Fee changes are subject to consultation; no change has yet been approved.

messages.text: Please meet our residents group to discuss the proposed fees.
A charging cable is exposed and sparking at the fictional depot. Please act now.
